subject: Exciting Career Opportunity at XYZ Company
body: Dear [Recipient], We are thrilled to inform you about a new job opening for a Senior Marketing Manager position at XYZ Company. This role offers the opportunity to lead a dynamic team, drive innovative marketing strategies, and make a significant impact on our brand's growth. If you have a strong background in marketing and a passion for creating impactful campaigns, we encourage you to apply. Please find attached the job description for more details. Best regards, [Your Name]
